name: claude-skills
description: Farhan Feroz's Claude Code plugins: session continuity, research, and review workflows.

plugins.name: session-continuity
plugins.description: Save session state into RESUME.md with /checkpoint, keep the prompt cache warm with /keepwarm, and have RESUME.md and DECISIONS.md delivered after /clear by a SessionStart hook. Works without ccage.

plugins.name: deep-research-tiered
plugins.description: Cost-tiered deep research: decompose in-session, approve scope, then a Sonnet-tiered fan-out (search -> fetch -> three-way verify with Opus appeals -> synthesize) producing a cited report. ~10x cheaper than all-Opus deep research; bundles the six dr-* agents it drives.

plugins.name: research-report
plugins.description: Author or revise a shareable technical note as a self-contained book chapter, enforced by a hard contract guard, a pdflatex book-chapter build, and a mandatory fresh-reader cold-read gate. Requires pandoc and a pdflatex/texlive install.

plugins.name: programme-plan
plugins.description: Structure and maintain the plan for a long, multi-strand programme running for weeks or months, where findings decay and many agents touch the same files. Treats a plan as a cache of disk state: cache less, check mechanically, invalidate in the same turn.

plugins.name: orchestration
plugins.description: Autonomous plan-execution: write an execution-level plan, dispatch it in dependency waves instead of walking the list, and enforce single-writer discipline and the decomposition doctrine with its guard hooks. Bundles writing-plans, executing-plans, and subagent-driven-development (modified forks of obra/superpowers, MIT) plus the guard hooks and routing policy.

plugins.name: review-suite
plugins.description: Tiered local code review (light -> critical): simplify -> bug/security finders -> false-positive verification -> external second opinion. Bundles tiered-review and the agy-run wrapper; the finder and second-opinion skills it calls are third-party and install from their own repositories (see README).

plugins.name: review-panel
plugins.description: Simulated pre-submission review panel for your own draft grant application: independent reviewers on more than one model family, a check against the author's own brief, and a moderator that verifies every criticism against the text. Configurable per funder; ships a UKRI distributed peer review profile.

plugins.name: playwright-agents
plugins.description: Wrap Playwright's first-party test agents: pin model/effort, wire the Test MCP into the project's .mcp.json, and verify generated specs with a real test run.

plugins.name: guards
plugins.description: Policy guards that refuse or rewrite risky tool calls and check code hygiene after edits; every decision is logged.

plugins.name: workers
plugins.description: Model-pinned worker agents (task-worker, task-worker-medium, utility-worker, adjudicator, claude, general-purpose) and the routing policy that says which to use when.

plugins.name: coding-standard
plugins.description: One coding standard (reuse, design, configurable settings, types, errors, performance, tests, style, reviews) loaded into every session by a SessionStart hook.

plugins.name: session-hooks
plugins.description: Session conveniences: a cost report at session start, tokenol start/stop, session-end cleanup, scratch pruning, and a chat-only session handoff skill.

plugins.name: research-method
plugins.description: Research procedure skills: figure workflow, methodology review, pre-training change checks, and grounding summaries in source notes.

plugins.name: talk-deck
plugins.description: Procedure for a talk or slide deck the presenter accepts: message and audience first, one prototype slide before the rollout, word caps, sourced numbers, render and look, cold read; with a deck checker.
